description: This file is a header file defining function declarations and include guards for a secure wrapper around system functions such as popen, pclose, and system in a C/C++ project.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Declaration of a secure version of popen function that executes a command and returns a file pointer.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Declaration of a function to close a FILE pointer returned by v_secure_popen.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Declaration of a secure version of system function to execute a command.
